content.text: The evidence clearly shows a clean failure signature: error rate and latency jump sharply at 15:55, with logs showing `PaymentProviderFailed: api.io-pay.example returned 503` starting exactly at onset and persisting at 100% thereafter. No changes were deployed to io-shop in the week prior. io-pay is registered as third-party, owned by IO Payments Ltd.

hypotheses.subject: api.io-pay.example
hypotheses.summary: io-shop's account page calls api.io-pay.example (IO Payments Ltd, third-party) to fetch the shopper's card while rendering. Starting at 15:55:00Z that dependency began returning HTTP 503, and io-shop's error rate and latency rose in lockstep (p50 jumping from ~45ms to ~2045ms, error rate from ~1% to 100%), with no deploys or config changes to io-shop in the preceding week.

supporting_evidence.claim: PaymentProviderFailed: api.io-pay.example returned 503 for /v1/shoppers/shopper-27210-4-0/card at src/io_shop/payment_provider.py:96
account page error rate at 100.00% over the last minute
io-pay: third-party, owned by IO Payments Ltd, at api.io-pay.example - Holds the card Io charges. Called while the account page renders
p50_ms jumped from 44 to 2045 and error_rate from 0.005 to 1.0 between 15:54:00Z and 15:56:00Z
